subject: Mark stale code entities for definitions removed inside a file
body:
Mark stale code entities for definitions removed inside a file

The incremental reindex path already swept per-file removed
definitions via mark_stale_for_removed_entities, but the full-index
path only marked whole-file deletions — entities for functions or
types removed inside a still-existing file stayed 'active' with stale
content, retrievable by search. Found via benchmark replay: a copied
pin-sha DB leaked the withheld fix's entities after reindex.

sync_code_entities now runs the same per-file sweep after the
file-level pass; removed ids flow to removed_entity_ids for knowledge
flagging.

subject: Close tombstone coherence and event-payload retention gaps
body:
Close tombstone coherence and event-payload retention gaps

External review (agent-memory-atlas, 6d664c8) prompted two fixes:

- Reject status: pruned files that still carry title or body — a
  tombstone is terminal and content-free; a contentful one is either
  malformed or an attempt to mint a terminal record through the parse
  path. Legitimate tombstone files (empty title+body) still sync.
- Strip old_content/new_content/title keys from an entity's event
  payloads at tombstone time and on cascade delete — pruning hides
  the record, so its text must not survive inside the audit log.
  Event type and timestamp are preserved.

subject: Normalize content hash to skip cosmetic code changes
body:
Normalize content hash to skip cosmetic code changes

The content hash for code entities now strips comments and normalizes
whitespace before hashing. This prevents cosmetic changes (comment
edits, formatting tweaks) from triggering stale-knowledge flagging.

Previously, adding a comment to a function would change its content
hash, causing it to be added to changed_code_ids, which triggered
flag_stale_knowledge on any knowledge referencing that function —
even though the code logic was unchanged.

The normalizer is language-aware: // and /* */ for C-like languages
(rust, go, javascript, typescript, tsx), # for python and bash.
String literals are preserved to avoid stripping comment-like text
inside strings.

Existing stale entities were reprocessed: all frontmatter status
fields reset to active, DB rebuilt from scratch with normalized
hashes. 0 stale entities after rebuild.

subject: Fix incremental edge sync data loss + sync docs to Phase 10 state
body:
Fix incremental edge sync data loss + sync docs to Phase 10 state

Incremental reindex was destroying structural edges from unchanged
files. sync_code_edges (full-scan function) was called with only
changed files, deleting all structural edges then reinserting only
from the changed subset. Fix: new sync_code_edges_incremental in
src/index/code_graph/incremental.rs builds name-to-UUID map from all
DB entities, deletes only edges sourced from changed-file entities,
preserves edges from unchanged files. Regression test in
src/storage/edges/tests.rs.

Documentation audit: architecture.md, testing-strategy.md, and
implementation-plan.md updated to reflect actual Phase 10 state —
consolidate/ no longer marked "not yet implemented", tool count
corrected to 12, CLI commands split into current vs planned, meta
table added to schema, consolidate tests unmarked from "planned",
Phase 10 incremental edge sync documented. hf-hub replaces reqwest
as planned model download dependency with .incomplete cleanup
strategy adapted from Mnemos fix.

subject: Phase 8 audit pass 3: fix stale edge accumulation + file-backed entity query
body:
Phase 8 audit pass 3: fix stale edge accumulation + file-backed entity query

Two bugs found during triple-audit of Phase 8 code indexing:

1. mark_deleted_as_stale (files/sync.rs): used `file_path IS NOT NULL`
   to find file-backed entities, but code entities also have file_path
   set. This caused 654 code entities to be spuriously marked stale
   during file sync. Fixed: filter by type IN ('observation','rule',
   'knowledge') instead.

2. sync_code_edges (index/code_graph/mod.rs): only inserted edges,
   never deleted old ones. When source code changed (function no
   longer calls X), the stale calls/imports/extends edge persisted.
   Each reindex accumulated duplicate edges. Fixed: delete all
   structural edges (calls, imports, extends) before re-inserting
   from fresh AST pass. References edges are preserved.

Added delete_edges_by_type to storage/edges.rs.
Added 2 tests: reindex_removes_stale_calls_edges,
reindex_preserves_references_edges.

Docs updated: architecture.md (module map, schema comments),
testing-strategy.md (phase-tagged test tables), implementation-plan.md
(edge count note).

281 tests pass, clippy clean, fmt clean.
